uz:
🎯 Omadli zarba
Oq shar bilan oltin sharni nishon markaziga yuboring! Har kuni bepul urinish bor, sharlar va nishon har safar yangi joyda chiqadi.
en:
🎯 Lucky Shot
Send the golden ball to the bullseye with the cue ball! There is a free try every day, and the balls and the target land in a new place every time.

uz:
🌆 Har shaharning o'z stoli
30 shahar, har birining o'ziga xos stoli: London, Madrid, Dubay va boshqalar. Qaysi stollarni ochdingiz?
en:
🌆 A table for every city
30 cities, each with its own table: London, Madrid, Dubai and more. Which tables have you unlocked?

uz:
🏆 Kunlik kubok turnirlari
Kuniga 4 marta turnir ochiladi: Morning, Noon, Evening va Night Cup. Qatnashing va kubok yuting!
en:
🏆 Daily cup tournaments
A tournament opens 4 times a day: Morning, Noon, Evening and Night Cup. Join and win cups!

uz:
🎱 Kiylar to'plami
Oddiy kiylardan premium kiylargacha: har birining o'z kuchi bor. O'z kolleksiyangizni yig'ing!
en:
🎱 Cue collection
From simple cues to premium ones, each with its own power. Build your own collection!

poll.uz: Qaysi o'yin rejimi sizga ko'proq yoqadi?
poll.en: Which game mode do you like most?
options: Do'stlar bilan lobbi / Lobby with friends

uz:
🎡 Omad g'ildiragi
Har 24 soatda bitta bepul aylantirish: tangalar, olmos, naqd pul va boshqa sovg'alar.
en:
🎡 Lucky wheel
One free spin every 24 hours: coins, gems, cash and other gifts.

uz:
🎁 Kunlik sovg'alar yo'li
Har kuni o'yinga kiring va sovg'a oling. Ketma-ket kirgan sari sovg'alar kattalashadi.
en:
🎁 Daily reward route
Open the game every day and collect a gift. The more days in a row, the bigger the gifts.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: aniq zarba
1) Nishon chizig'ini sharga to'g'rilang.
2) Kuchni me'yorida tanlang: ortiqcha kuch oq sharni ham yo'qotishi mumkin.
3) Sinov o'yinida (Practice) tinch mashq qiling.
en:
💡 Tip: a clean shot
1) Line the aim guide up with the ball.
2) Pick a moderate power: too much force can lose the cue ball too.
3) Practice calmly in the Practice game.

uz:
🎮 Mini-o'yinlar
Spin & Win, Lucky Shot, Golden Shot, Scratch & Win va Surprise Boxes: asosiy o'yin orasida dam olish uchun.
en:
🎮 Minigames
Spin & Win, Lucky Shot, Golden Shot, Scratch & Win and Surprise Boxes: a break between the main games.

uz:
⚡ Maxsus tadbirlar
Grandmaster Table, Showdown, King's Gambit va boshqa tadbirlar: o'zingizni sinab ko'ring!
en:
⚡ Special events
Grandmaster Table, Showdown, King's Gambit and more: test yourself!

uz:
🩸 Mavsum yo'li (Season Pass)
O'yinlarda g'alaba qozonib, vazifalarni bajaring va mukofotlarni oching.
en:
🩸 Season Pass
Win matches, complete missions and unlock the rewards.

uz:
🎮 Hammasi bir joyda
1 vs 1, 16–64 o'yinchilik kubok, tadbirlar, mini-o'yinlar va do'st bilan o'yin. Telegram'da, bepul.
en:
🎮 Everything in one place
1 vs 1, cups for 16–64 players, events, minigames and a game with a friend. In Telegram, free to play.

text.uz:
🎙 Ovozli chat bilan o'ynang
8 kishigacha lobbi: do'stlaringizni havola bilan taklif qiling va o'yin vaqtida jonli gaplashing.
text.en:
🎙 Play with voice chat
A lobby for up to 8 players: invite your friends with a link and talk live while you play.

text.uz:
🙏 Kanalga obuna bo'lganingiz uchun rahmat!
O'yin sizga yoqdimi? Savol yoki taklifingiz bo'lsa, shu yerda yozing. Hammasini o'qiymiz.
text.en:
🙏 Thank you for subscribing!
Do you like the game? If you have a question or an idea, write it here. We read everything.
